metas.name: Architecture - BRICK CORNICES
metas.note: Houses with prominent brick cornices below the eaves are fairly common in eastern Bulgaria, in a band from eastern Haskovo Province to Varna Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CHIMNEYS WITH MANY WINDOWS
metas.note: Chimneys with multiple openings can sometimes be found in southwestern Bulgaria, especially near Smolyan. For this clue to be reliable, the chimney must have more than three openings on a single side.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CINDER BLOCK WALLS, DECORATIVE PATTERNS
metas.note:
Cinder block boundary walls with repeating decorative blocks are found in eastern Bulgaria.

Note that plain cinder block walls can be found throughout the whole country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CINDER BLOCK WALLS, DIAMOND PATTERN
metas.note: Cinder block walls featuring this diamond pattern are quite common in Varna Province, but do occasionally appear further north.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CINDER BLOCK WALLS, FLORAL PATTERN
metas.note: Cinder block walls with this four-petaled floral pattern are common in northern Burgas Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CIRCULAR CHIMNEY OPENINGS
metas.note: Circular chimney openings appear predominantly in and around Pleven Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CONCRETE WALLS WITH OVERLAPPING CIRCLE PATTERN
metas.note: Concrete boundary walls with various overlapping circle motifs are quite common across Ruse and Veliko Tarnovo provinces, but also appear occasionally across the Upper Thracian Plain.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - CORN CRIBS
metas.note: Corn cribs are narrow, elevated, ventilated granaries for storing and drying corn, and are found mostly near the Romanian border, especially in Vratsa and Pleven provinces. They may be constructed of metal or wood.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - IRREGULAR FLAT STONE CONSTRUCTION
metas.note: Irregularly shaped flat stone architecture can be found in several pockets across Bulgaria, as indicated on the map.The colours of the stone can range from a sandy yellow to grey. Low boundary walls made from similar stones are also common.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - IRREGULAR RED STONE CONSTRUCTION
metas.note: Irregular dark red to purplish stone walls are characteristic of western Bulgaria. This material typically features in the foundations of buildings or in mortared boundary walls.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - LADDER POLES
metas.note: Ladder poles can be found in virtually every part of Bulgaria, but they are significantly more common in the north and west of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - MOESIA BEIGE BRICKS
metas.note: A beige colour scheme can be seen in the architecture of some towns in the Ruse–Shumen–Veliko Tarnovo triangle. Beige brick walls are a particularly good indicator for this region. Mud bricks, light-coloured stone and beige painted walls are also common, but should only be taken as clues for this area when the entire neighbourhood is predominantly beige in colour.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - OPEN BARNS
metas.note: Wooden barns with an open upper storey are mainly found in Vidin Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - OTHER THICK CORNICES
metas.note: These thick cornices are commonly found between Plovdiv and Dobrich provinces and are also present in far northwestern Bulgaria. They can rarely be found elsewhere.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - PENTAGONAL CHIMNEY TOPS
metas.note:
These pentagonal chimney tops, resembling a simple outline of a house, are found in the southern areas shown on the map, being most common around Plovdiv.

A similar style of chimney, where the diagonal sides have a slight overhang, can be found in parts of northern Bulgaria, most commonly in Vratsa, Pleven and Silistra provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - RECTANGLE WALL MOTIF
metas.note: Along the Romanian border in Silistra Province, you will sometimes see this repeating motif of rectangles with cut-out corners just below the eaves of buildings, with no wooden eave supports present. The colour scheme can vary.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - RHODOPES BARNS
metas.note:
Barns in the Western Rhodopes often have a stone ground storey and a wooden upper storey. The barns sometimes have quite a towering appearance and often feature vertically arranged boards of uneven length.

Barns with a concrete ground storey can also be found in the Rhodopes, but these are a less reliable indicator for the region.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - ROCKS ON ROOFS
metas.note: The use of loose natural stones as simple weights on top of roofs is particularly common in rural communities in the eastern half of the Balkan Mountains and in the other locations shown on the map. Elsewhere in the country, you are more likely to see bricks, pavers etc. being used in this manner instead.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SIMPLE BRUSH FENCES
metas.note: Boundary fences made from loose brushwood, sometimes layered on top of stone walls, are found in and near Kardzhali Province. Similar material can also be arranged into loose wattle fences in this area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SIMPLE SLOPED TILE CHIMNEY
metas.note: This simple style of chimney top made from tile pieces leaning against one another to form a triangle is most common around Plovdiv and in eastern Bulgaria, and can also be found in far northwestern Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SLANTED TRIANGLE CHIMNEYS
metas.note: Chimneys with this design, formed of slanted triangular openings, are found in northeastern Bulgaria. They are most common in Razgrad, Shumen and Silistra provinces. A few can also be found near Momchilgrad in Kardzhali Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SLAT BARNS
metas.note:
Barns with walls made from horizontal wooden slats with noticeable gaps in between them are found in inland northern Bulgaria.

Barns with slats arranged diagonally, rather than horizontally, are most commonly found in Vidin Province, although they can be rarely found elsewhere in the area shown.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SLATE ROOF STONE VILLAGES
metas.note: If you are in a village with numerous slate-roofed houses with stone walls, you should be in one of the three distinct areas shown on the map.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SLATE ROOFS
metas.note: Slate roofs can be found in parts of southern Bulgaria and around the Balkan Mountains.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SLATE TOPPED STONE WALLS
metas.note:
Stone boundary walls topped with a single layer of slate slabs can be found in the Gabrovo–Lovech–Veliko Tarnovo triangle.

In Pavlikeni Municipality, these slate slabs are sometimes thicker and laid diagonally on top of walls rather than horizontally.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - SOUTHWESTERN WATER TANKS
metas.note:
Long, narrow, metal water tanks can be seen on many rooftops throughout southwestern Bulgaria and also around Burgas.

While far less common, water tanks in other styles (e.g. these white tanks with coloured ends) are not reliable regional indicators.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - STAGGERED BRICK WALLS
metas.note: Brick boundary walls with a repeating pattern of gaps are mostly found in the northern and central parts of Bulgaria shown on the map, though they can also appear south of the Balkan Mountains.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - STAGGERED BRICK WALLS, DIAMOND PATTERN
metas.note: In Veliko Tarnovo Province, brick walls with gaps almost always use this diamond pattern.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - STONE WALLS WITH HORIZONTAL TIMBERS
metas.note: Stone architecture featuring exposed timbers appears frequently across southern Bulgaria and less often around the Balkan Mountains. Unlike the timber-framed architecture above, these stone buildings typically feature horizontal timbers only.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - THICK MORTAR STONE WALLS
metas.note: Architecture featuring irregular stones and thick mortar, often smeared over the stones, is indicative of southern Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - TILED RIDGE ROOFS
metas.note: Corrugated-sheet roofs with tiled ridges can be found in southern and eastern Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord.

metas.name: Architecture - TIMBER FRAMING WITH CLAY
metas.note:
Timber-framed architecture composed of a wooden lattice layered with smooth clay (‘wattle and daub’) is mainly found in the regions surrounding Sofia and also the regions continuing further east into the Balkan Mountains.

In western Pernik Province and western Sofia Province, you can see a variant of this with closely spaced horizontal timbers and narrow rows of clay infill.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - TIMBER FRAMING WITH MUD BRICKS
metas.note: Timber framing with mud-brick infill is mainly found around the Central Balkan Mountains.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - TIMBER FRAMING WITH RED BRICKS
metas.note: The distribution of timber-framed architecture in Bulgaria roughly corresponds with the hilly and mountainous regions of the country. Exposed red-brick infill can be found throughout this area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - TRIANGLE ATTACHMENT POLE SUPPORTS
metas.note:
In Western Bulgaria (the area covered by Electrohold), the lowest insulator support on some pole tops can have a long, solid triangular shape.

This triangular shape is usually made of a thin sheet of metal. However, if you find one that is considerably thicker, you are likely to be no further north than Sofia Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - WIDE METAL BARS FENCE
metas.note: Household fences with wide metal fence posts are common across most of Silistra and Dobrich provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - WOODEN EAVE SUPPORTS
metas.note: Rows of vertical wooden supports can be found under the eaves of some buildings throughout northern and western Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - WOODEN HOUSES
metas.note: Traditional wooden houses can be found in many parts of Bulgaria, but are particularly common in certain areas, most notably the Strandzha region in southern Burgas Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Culture - MOSQUES
metas.note: Mosques, indicative of areas with Muslim populations, are mostly seen in northeastern Bulgaria and around the Rhodopes. There is also a significant Muslim community near Kazanlak in northern Stara Zagora Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - “ERYUG” POLE MARKERS
metas.note: Pole markers featuring the black-and-red ‘ЕР ЮГ’ logo are found in all provinces in the EVN distribution area (southeastern Bulgaria). These are the only pole markers in Bulgaria that are physically affixed to the pole rather than painted on it.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - “GOD REMONT” POLE MARKERS
metas.note: Pole markers with год ремонт (‘god. remont’ meaning ‘maintenance year’) written on them can be found in Vidin, Vratsa and Montana provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - “GODINA” POLE MARKERS
metas.note:
Pole markers with a row beginning with the Cyrillic letter г, which stands for година (‘godina’ meaning ‘year’), can be found primarily in Pleven and Lovech provinces.

About half the time with these pole markers, the heading for each row is followed by a printed underscore (e.g. “г ___”) which may or may not contain text. This can help to confirm your regionguess in cases where the ‘г’ is faded or otherwise illegible.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - “IZVOD” POLE MARKERS
metas.note: Pole markers in the EVN distribution area (southeastern Bulgaria) usually include a row starting with извод (‘izvod’) or its abbreviations изв or из. Similar pole markings also appear in Vidin Province and the city of Kyustendil.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - 7-SIDED SIGNBACK
metas.note: This seven-sided white signback sticker (which can point either up or down) is mostly found in the area shown on the map. In particular, it is virtually absent from western Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - BLACK LOGO SIGNBACK
metas.note: This white or yellow rectangular signback sticker featuring a small black logo is mainly found in western Bulgaria. It also features two rows of bold text, placed either underneath or to the right of the logo.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - BLACK MATERIAL
metas.note: Electricity wires wrapped in thick black sleeves near the insulator are particularly common in eastern Bulgaria, especially in and around Yambol Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - BLAGOEVGRAD BLUE BULGE BUS SHELTER
metas.note: In northern Blagoevgrad Province, around Blagoevgrad and Razlog, you can find these unique blue bus shelters with walls that bulge outwards and two or three curved roof sections.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - BOX POLETOP
metas.note: This pole top with a boxy shape can be found in Targovishte, Shumen and Silistra provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - BURGAS BOLLARDS
metas.note: The city of Burgas uses grey street bollards with a single thick red stripe.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The city of Plovdiv uses the two styles of street sign shown in the graphic.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: Sofia City Province uses street signs with a coloured bar at the bottom and a partial bar in the same colour on the top. Various colours are used. (Note that the spa town of Devin in Smolyan Province also uses red Sofia-style signs).
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The town of Samokov uses somewhat similar street signs to those found in Botevgrad municipality, with a darker green and different coat of arms.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: Razlog Municipality has street signs with two-tone brown bars, similar to Sofia’s colour-bar signs.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: Bansko Municipality has brown street signs with the Bansko coat of arms.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: Botevgrad Municipality uses this green and white street sign.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The city of Blagoevgrad has a yellow horse emblem on its street signs and has an unusual arrow shape.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The town of Svilengrad uses street signs with a white top, blue bottom and a small crest.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: Sozopol Municipality uses street signs with a blue top, white bottom and a black arrow.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The city of Stara Zagora mainly uses brown street signs with gold text and borders; however, you can sometimes find green signs.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The city of Dobrich sometimes uses some street signs with a yellow arrow design.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CITY SPECIFIC STREET SIGNS
metas.note: The city of Kardzhali uses this simple yet distinctive street sign which is white with a thin blue strip at the bottom.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - CYLINDRICAL BUS SHELTERS
metas.note: Bus stop shelters with an open cylindrical shape, a bit like a tin can that has been cut in two, are most common in Pleven Province. Some also appear in Lovech and Veliko Tarnovo provinces. They can be painted in a wide range of colours.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - DOBRICH POLETOP
metas.note: If you see a ‘flipped’ version of the Varna pole top, with each diagonal support above the horizontal arm instead of below it, you are most likely to be in Dobrich Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - DOUBLE FRAME POLE MARKERS
metas.note: Pole markers with a black border formed of two rectangles can be found across northern Bulgaria, particularly in Silistra, Shumen and Varna provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - ELECTROHOLD & CEZ INFRASTRUCTURE
metas.note:
ЕРМ Запад (‘ERM Zapad’) is the electricity distributor for western Bulgaria, having rebranded from ЧЕЗ (CEZ) in 2022.

ЕРМ Запад has an orange logo, but it is still quite rare to find this on infrastructure visible in street view.

However, two styles of long stickers with blue text dating from before the name change can still be seen on some electricity boxes:

  • Stickers with a blue ‘E’ logo and the text ‘софия област’(Sofia Oblast) can be found in Sofia Province and the provinces south of it in the distribution area.
  • Stickers without the blue ‘E’ logo and the text ‘плевен’ (Pleven) can be found in the provinces north of Sofia Province in the distribution area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - ENERGO-PRO INFRASTRUCTURE
metas.note: ЕРП Север (‘ERP Sever’) is the electricity distributor for northeastern Bulgaria. Their blue-on-white logo is fairly common on electricity boxes in this area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - EVN & ERYUG INFRASTRUCTURE
metas.note:
ЕР ЮГ (‘ER Yug’), a subsidiary of EVN, is the electricity distributor for southeastern Bulgaria.

The black EVN logo is more common on electricity boxes. However, you can also see the red-and-black ЕР ЮГ logo on newer pole markers – see the meta in the pole marker section.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - FAKE DOBRICH-VARNA POLETOP
metas.note:
This rare pole top is occasionally found in Stara Zagora and Haskovo provinces. It has a bend in the diagonal support where it reaches the pole, which can be seen if you are lucky enough to get a close-up view.

It is worth knowing mainly because it can easily be confused with the Varna and Dobrich pole tops.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - GROUNDING ICON POLE MARKERS
metas.note:
Pole markers with this grounding icon (a black icon resembling an inverted Christmas tree) are found in much of the Electrohold energy distribution area (western Bulgaria).

Note that you can also see pole markers with this icon in the Svilengrad area of Haskovo Province. These always feature either the text извод (‘izvod’) or one of its abbreviations, ‘изв’ or ‘из’.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - HANGING INSULATORS
metas.note: Hanging insulators are mainly found in northeastern Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - HUNGARY-STYLE HIGHWAY BOLLARDS
metas.note: Highway bollards similar to those found in Hungary are used throughout the country, but they are relatively uncommon outside northeastern Bulgaria. They can be solid and wedge-shaped or thin and curved.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD LETTERS
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers that are labelled alphabetically (e.g. ‘изв B’) are found in the regions shown, notably including Pleven and Stara Zagora provinces, as well as in southern Kardzhali Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD MARKERS WITH TALL FRAMES
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers with tall black frames (i.e. taller than they are wide) are typically seen in Haskovo and Kardzhali provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD MARKERS WITH WIDE FRAMES
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers with wide black frames are found towards the east, mainly Sliven and Burgas provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD NUMBERS
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers that are labelled numerically (e.g. ‘изв 4’) instead of alphabetically are found in these areas, which include all the provinces bordering Turkey.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD WITH “№”
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers with a row labelled “№” (without “ст”) are found most often in Yambol Province, but can be seen as far west as Pazardzhik.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD WITH “ST”
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers with a row labelled “ст” (without the №) appear in four clear clusters: Burgas and Sliven provinces, Haskovo Province, northern Pazardzhik Province, and Vidin Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - IZVOD WITH “STALB №”
metas.note:
‘Izvod’ pole markers featuring a row labelled ‘ст №’ (meaning ‘pole number’) are found in the western part of the EVN distribution area.

Note that nearly all ‘ст №’ pole markers without an ‘izvod’ line instead have a ‘год ремонт’ line. Based on that meta, these should be found in northwestern Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - KARDZHALI BUS SHELTERS
metas.note: In the south of Kardzhali Province, including Momchilgrad, Krumovgrad and Kirkovo municipalities, you can find these green or blue bus shelters with a yellow strip across the front. The yellow strip sometimes includes the municipality (община) or town name.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - LEFT SIDE WARNING SIGNBACK
metas.note:
Signback stickers featuring a red, downward-pointing triangle ‘warning’ symbol on the left side of the sticker are mostly found in Varna Province, and more generally in northeastern Bulgaria.

Note that stickers with a centred, upward-pointing ‘warning’ symbol can be found across the whole country, but are virtually absent from the northeast of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - MARITSA COMPLEX
metas.note:
The Maritsa Power Plant complex has three main plants in the southeast of Stara Zagora Province. Each plant features large cooling towers or smoke stacks that can be recognised from far away in the vast, flat landscape of the Upper Thracian Plain.

Other comparably large power plants in Bulgaria are located in hillier or more urban settings.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - NORTHEASTERN POLETOP
metas.note: In northeastern Bulgaria, you can find similar pole tops, but the support reaches the end of the horizontal arm, forming a narrower triangular opening.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - ORANGE CIRCLE SIGNBACK
metas.note: Signback stickers with an orange circular shape also tend to appear in eastern Bulgaria, but their distribution is more widespread.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - PERNIK POLE MARKERS
metas.note:
In Pernik Province, pole markers usually have minimal text, often just a single letter above a number that is one or two digits.

These markings often have a ‘tombstone’ shape, allowing them to be recognised at a distance even without the black text. Sometimes an empty ‘tombstone’ marking can accompany a rectangular marking with the text. However, a similar shape rarely appears in other provinces, so use this tip with caution.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - PERNIK/SOFIA POLE MARKERS
metas.note: Similar pole markings, with a letter above two rows of numbers, the top row having one digit and the lower row (indicating the year) having two digits, can be found in Pernik and Sofia provinces. This format is slightly more typical in the western parts of both provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - PLOVDIV BOLLARDS
metas.note: The city of Plovdiv uses these street bollards with exactly three black stripes and two yellow stripes.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - RECTANGLE AND CIRCLE SIGNBACK
metas.note: This signback sticker has a distinctive shape with a circle overlapping the top-right corner of a rectangle. It can be found nationwide, but is much more common in southern Bulgaria, as well as in the Shumen and Targovishte area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - RECTANGULAR POLETOP
metas.note: This pole top has supports which form openings shaped like a rectangle with an elongated corner. It is most common in Ruse, Razgrad and Silistra provinces, but appears occasionally elsewhere.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - RED OCTAGON SIGNBACK
metas.note:
This red octagonal sticker (resembling a stop sign) is mainly found in Shumen and Varna provinces, as well as in northern Burgas Province.

Note that from a distance, these stickers can be confused with the orange circular signback stickers mentioned below.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SKINNY HOLEY POLES
metas.note: Holey poles are sometimes found in northern Bulgaria, especially around the city of Veliko Tarnovo.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SOFIA CITY PROVINCE BUS STOP TRASH BIN
metas.note: Bus stops in Sofia City Province can have a wide variety of sign and shelter styles. However, one piece of infrastructure is remarkably consistent: these dark grey rubbish bins with two yellow stripes. You can find one at virtually every bus stop in the region, including at most bus stops without shelters.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SOFIA HOLEY POLES
metas.note:
More rarely, you will also find a variant of these holey poles in and around Sofia Province. These can be distinguished from regular holey poles by the indent on the bars in between the holes.

Additionally, very wide holey poles, which are always this variant, are only found in this region.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SOFIA PROVINCE POLE MARKERS
metas.note: In Sofia Province, you can see pole markers with two rows of text spaced far apart. The format of the text itself varies, and the text can be positioned in the corners of the pole marker. Sometimes there is a red lightning bolt icon between the two rows, but often it is absent.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SOFIA THICK BOLLARDS
metas.note:
These thick ‘street bollards’ with two stripes can be found in the city of Sofia. There are two characteristic colour schemes: black with yellow, orange or white stripes, and yellow with white stripes.

The yellow-on-black design is easy to remember, as it matches the Sofia City Province bus stop bin.

Note that the white-on-yellow style also appears rarely in the city of Burgas.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SOFIA WHITE NUMBERS
metas.note: In Sofia City Province, you can see vertical white numbers written on some poles.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SOUTHEASTERN POLETOP
metas.note:
In southeastern Bulgaria, you often find pole tops with supports reaching about halfway across the horizontal arm, forming a wide triangular opening.

This is the only pole top in southeastern Bulgaria that ever has hanging insulators.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SPELLED OUT “IZVOD” MARKERS
metas.note: ‘Izvod’ pole markers that use the full word извод instead of an abbreviation are generally found in Burgas, Sliven and Stara Zagora provinces.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - SQUARE “EARS” BUS SHELTER
metas.note: Bus shelters with two protruding square shapes on either side of the roof, almost resembling ears, can be found in the centre-north of Bulgaria as shown on the map. The colour schemes of these shelters vary.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - STARA ZAGORA BOLLARDS
metas.note: The city of Stara Zagora uses grey street bollards with a single orange stripe. This bollard may rarely appear outside the city in Stara Zagora Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - THIN INSULATORS
metas.note: Insulators that are unusually thin are mostly used in eastern Bulgaria, and especially in the southeast of the country.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - TRAM TRACKS
metas.note: Sofia is the only city in Bulgaria with tram tracks embedded in the roads. In other Bulgarian cities, you can find trolleybus systems with overhead wires, but no tracks.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - VARNA POLETOP
metas.note: This variant of the northeastern pole top above occurs mostly in Varna Province and neighbouring parts of Shumen and Dobrich provinces. It has two diagonal supports for each insulator (one on either side of the pole). Each of these crosses the pole, rather than stopping when it reaches the pole.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - WIND TURBINES
metas.note: Wind turbines are most common in southern Dobrich Province, but can be found in several other regions of the country as well.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - BELOGRADCHIK ROCK FORMATIONS
metas.note: In the town of Belogradchik and some surrounding areas, you might spot these unique towering, pillared rock formations.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - BLAGOEVGRAD SANDY CLIFFS
metas.note: Steep sandstone escarpments, such as the Melnik Earth Pyramids, can be seen in southern Blagoevgrad Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - CHUPRENE MOUNTAINS
metas.note: Chuprene Municipality in Vidin Province is very mountainous, containing the highest peak in the Western Balkan Mountains. Mountains here often have a distinctive asymmetrical ‘wave-like’ appearance.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - EASTERN RHODOPES
metas.note:
The Rhodope Mountains (often simply ‘the Rhodopes’) are a mountain range spanning most of the border between Bulgaria and Greece.

The Eastern Rhodopes, which run through Kardzhali and Haskovo provinces, are typically much drier and more open than the Western Rhodopes and have less coniferous forest. It is common to see scattered rocks and stone walls in the Eastern Rhodopes.

The Eastern Rhodopes are also more hilly than mountainous, which can help distinguish them from the Western Rhodopes, although some taller mountains can still be found.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - FLAT SANDY HILLS
metas.note: Unusually flat-topped hills can be seen between the cities of Shumen and Varna, and to the south of Shumen. These hills often have exposed limestone slopes but can also be covered in trees. You may also occasionally spot rocky escarpments.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - MOESIA ROCK VALLEYS
metas.note: In the Ruse–Shumen–Veliko Tarnovo triangle, you can sometimes find fairly low, rugged limestone cliff faces. This whole area is slightly hilly, in contrast to other parts of the Danubian Plain.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - PIRIN & RILA
metas.note: Pirin and Rila National Parks both feature dramatic, towering mountains which can have pyramid-like peaks. These are the only mountains in Bulgaria that commonly feature snowcaps in summer.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - ROSE VALLEY
metas.note: The Rose Valley is the relatively narrow valley just south of the Central Balkan Mountains. It is quite flat and heavily cultivated, and is often easy to recognise because of the E-W mountain ranges that you can frequently see quite nearby to both the north and south.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - SHUMEN MONUMENT
metas.note: The Monument to 1300 Years of Bulgaria can be spotted to the south from various locations in the city of Shumen.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - SLIVENSKA PLANINA
metas.note: Slivenska Planina is a section of the Eastern Balkan Mountains that forms a craggy grey wall immediately to the north of the city of Sliven, making it easy to identify the city. Another useful landmark for identifying Sliven is the large white cross on a forested peak slightly to the west of the Slivenska Planina ridge.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - STEEP GRAY CLIFF LANDSCAPES
metas.note: Tall mountain rock faces, usually of grey rock, are generally found in two areas: the western half of the Balkan Mountains, and the southern Rila–Rhodope Massif.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - STRUMA VALLEY
metas.note: The warm, southern portion of the Struma River Valley is notable for its Mediterranean climate and features many large vineyards as well as areas with greenhouses. It is flanked by N-S mountain ridges on either side.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - TREE-LINED FIELDS
metas.note: Most of Dobrich Province has an extremely distinctive landscape, featuring flat farm fields that are often divided by long rows of trees running perpendicular to the road.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - VITOSHA
metas.note: Vitosha is a gradually sloping but very prominent mountain south of Sofia, serving as a useful reference point for identifying the flatter valley surrounding the city.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - YAMBOL FREEDOM MONUMENT
metas.note: The Monument to 110 Years of Freedom can be seen slightly to the east of the city of Yambol.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: SOFIA HOLEY POLES
metas.note: More rarely, you will also find a variant of these holey poles in and around Sofia Province. These can be distinguished from regular holey poles by the indent on the bars in between the holes.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - CORN
metas.note: Corn is found throughout much of Bulgaria but is most commonly seen in the north.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - DOG ROSE
metas.note: Dog rose (Rosa canina) is a shrub with characteristic pinkish-white, five-petaled flowers. It is mostly found in northern and western Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - FIR
metas.note: Fir trees (Abies alba) can look very similar to spruces, but, unlike spruces, their branches resemble a flat fan shape. They are found in some of the highest altitude areas of the country i.e. the Western Rhodopes, Pirin National Park and Rila National Park.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - FIREWEED
metas.note: Fireweed (Chamaenerion angustifolium) is found in high-altitude areas in the southwest of the country and specifically in the Western Rhodopes, Rila National Park and Vitosha National Park. It can be recognised by its pink flowers, spear-shaped inflorescence and thin leaves.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - LAVENDER FIELDS
metas.note: Lavender is easily recognised by its purple flowers and is usually grown in ‘clumpy’ rows, making it identifiable even when it is not in flower. It is most commonly seen in Dobrich Province and in central Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - MULLEIN
metas.note: Mullein (Verbascum spp.) has a wide range but is predominantly found in the western half of Bulgaria. It is easily recognised by its candelabra-like yellow inflorescence.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - OAK FORESTS
metas.note: While individual oaks (Quercus spp.) are not useful for regionguessing, forests dominated by oak are a good indicator for southeastern Bulgaria. Oak trees can be identified by the characteristic lobed shape of their leaves.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - RAPESEED
metas.note: Rapeseed can be recognised by its yellow flowers and is particularly common in Yambol Province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - SCOTS PINE
metas.note: Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris) can be recognised by its red trunk, with the bottom section of the trunk being darker and more brown rather than red. It is found in all the mountainous regions but is particularly common and abundant in the Rhodopes.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - SPRUCE
metas.note: Spruce trees (Picea abies) can be recognised by their drooping branches with the secondary branches hanging down from the primary branch. They are found in the southwestern mountains and, less commonly, the Central Balkan mountains.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - TEASEL
metas.note: Teasel (Dipsacus laciniatus) can be recognised by its spiky flower head. The tough structure of the plant is highly resilient, allowing its dried seedheads to remain standing after the plant has died. It is especially common around Sofia and Pernik. You can also find it less commonly in the other areas shown on the map.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - VINEYARDS
metas.note: Vineyards can be found in a few pockets throughout Bulgaria, particularly in the Upper Thracian Plain.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - VIPER’S BUGLOSS
metas.note: Viper’s bugloss (Echium vulgare) is recognisable by its blue-purple flowers that are each individually attached to a central stem by a small flower stalk (rather than being directly attached to the stem). It is particularly common in the Western Rhodopes.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Bulgaria Guide. Join our discord Real Meta Research Group Discord
